title: Rent Our Ski

services.name: Jet Ski
services.desc: As per the City of Toronto's new waterfront regulations, a CITY-WIDE JET-SKI RENTAL BAN is in effect for all commercial operations pending a 2027 permit pilot. As a result, every rental company has been forced to relocate outside city limits to continue operating for the 2026 season. There are NO permitted Jet-Ski Rental companies allowed to operate in Toronto for 2026. All unlicensed city operators are facing severe daily crackdowns. Renting from any public boat ramp, any city parks, any city beaches, or any marina means your ride will be stopped, searched, and machines towed. Both riders & passengers face massive personal fines (up to $2,500) from Marine Police & Toronto Bylaw Officers.

quotes.author: Ruekevwe
quotes.text: I had a BLASTTT. He gives a mini lesson so you’re VERY prepared. There’s also Bluetooth speaker and a waterproof bag for your phones and wallet. He’s a very nice guy and he’s funny.

quotes.author: O Ba Linh
quotes.text: The guys at Rent Our Ski are Top-Notch! Best Fun I ever had in my life hands down!. As a first-timer to jet-skiing in Toronto, it was fantastic, and the jetskis were very clean, fast, & and also had Bluetooth speakers too. Anyone looking for a fun day on the waters of Lake Ontario in Toronto should not hesitate to contact Rent Our Ski.

quotes.author: A V
quotes.text: We had a really great time renting Jet Skis from Rent Our Ski in Toronto and checking out some famous local Landmarks such as: CN Tower, Toronto Islands, & Harbourfront from the water. Seeing Toronto from the water was just amazing and I can't wait to do it again, when we're back in Toronto. These guys gave us 10/10 service, and we would recommend their Jet Ski Rental Services in Toronto!

quotes.author: K MP
quotes.text: I had the best time riding a Jet Ski from Rent Our Ski. It was a spontaneous idea since it was the end of the season because I stumbled across it online. Jet-Skiing was always on my bucket list. So I was very surprised it was at Woodbine Beach in Toronto. The Rent Our Ski team gave an extremely thorough safety lesson, and issued a temporary boating licence. I felt very prepared to take on the waves of Lake Ontario. I found myself rediscovering the city by riding the jet ski on the lake waters. As a Toronto native there's not too many new activities to try but this really surpassed my expectations. I will definitely be coming back to ride next summer in 2025.

quotes.author: Samir Mimou
quotes.text: My friends and I as a group had a blast!! renting jet-skis from Rent Our Ski in Toronto. The process was very smooth from start to finish. Their website is extremely user-friendly to navigate to complete payment when we made our reservation online, and their launch location where you start your jet-ski ride is near Woodbine Beach and is very easy to find at Rent Our Ski / Jet Ski Launch-Location, which allows easy access to Lake Ontario. They also provided us a thorough safety and jet-ski operational training before we ventured out on our own because we were all beginners to jet-skiing.

quotes.author: Rikin Patel
quotes.text: Great ski and wonderful location to start with!

quotes.author: Akif Ashraf
quotes.text: My first time on the jet ski and it was an amazing experience. Loved every bit of it. Rent Our Ski conducted a professional debrief with prominent instructions before we hit the water, it was promising and safe altogether. Thank you for a wonderful time and experience. I will be back

quotes.author: Thiago Lima
quotes.text: The staff is great and the experience was awesome. They give clear instructions, and also provide a waterproof bag to keep the temporary boating license. Make sure to check all safety equipments for yourself. There are police boats on the water and you never know when they might ask you to pull over for a routine check.

quotes.author: Saed Alavinia
quotes.text: We had a fabulous time! Andrew was amazing! He is caring, sarcastic, and gives his customer the care and attention they need! We loved it and we will come back again here for sure
The best experience of my life
